description: This file defines the internal implementation of the GrainDirectoryPartition class, including methods for registering, looking up, and deregistering grain addresses, as well as internal core methods and logging helpers. It is part of the Orleans runtime's grain directory management.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: An internal sealed partial class managing grain address registration, lookup, and deregistration within the Orleans runtime's grain directory.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address asynchronously, ensuring membership version is current and ownership is verified.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain address asynchronously by grain ID, verifying ownership and membership version.

methods.name: DeregisterAsync
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address asynchronously, verifying ownership and membership version.

methods.name: DeregisterCore
methods.description: Core method to remove a grain address from the directory if conditions are met.

methods.name: LookupCore
methods.description: Core method to retrieve a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: RegisterCore
methods.description: Core method to register or update a grain address in the directory.

methods.name: IsSiloDead
methods.description: Checks if the silo hosting the grain address is dead.

methods.name: LogRegisterAsync
methods.description: Logs registration attempts at trace level.

methods.name: LogLookupAsync
methods.description: Logs lookup attempts at trace level.

methods.name: LogDeregisterAsync
methods.description: Logs deregistration attempts at trace level.
